content: Iyakwen Yeisuw
Yowbad Kululuwan mo itok Yeisuw, inow wanawoud, va̱gan Seitan biyakwen.
Ipos sinawavas yam; ta-kweitan kan ikam yam waseg o boug waseg, nag. Ikous, mo ivag anamoun.
Tayakwanein gamags mo isap, ilana, “Magat ya̱koum Yowbad Natun yak, amlivan kusek dakul tasiyas mo bimlavag bled bukukwam.”
Yeisuw ikatimop aygan, ilana, “Bukitab waseg livan nises mamagina:

content.text: ‘Kan makaw nag biyamov gamag; nag. Tage Yowbad anilivan kweitan kweitan mo biyamoves gamags.’”

content: Ikous sinap towen, Seitan mo itok Yeisuw inow Yelusalem waseg, itamnow Yowbad nabunatum wakunuwatan, idibek, ilana, “Magat ya̱koum Yowbad Natun yak, kwaspepel kun watinow. Nag aveiyag bivag, peinan livan nises Bukitab waseg mamagina:

content.text: ‘Bo bisek nataka̱yobs siwotet va̱gan bimtakavateims, binupeims yak; mata ge dakul iweiy kakeim.’”

content: Yeisuw idibek, ilana, “Kweitan livan nises mamagina:
Sivtounun mo itok Yeisuw, inow koy singay avakaein, ikatimlek vena babaw ikous, ikin vena babaw bwana̱bweins.
Yeisuw ikin ikous, Seitan mo idibek ilana, “Kukulul wamatag mo basekeim vena babaw, wunsiyas ven mukwaleiwag ya̱koum.”
Yeisuw mo ikan Seitan, ilana, “Kusineikik. Bukitab waseg kweitan livan nises mamagina:
Seitan mo ilisow Yeisuw, inoun. Yowbad nataka̱yobs mo imeis, ilabes Yeisuw.
Isilamaw nawotet ven Galiliy waseg
Wankuyeim kweitan tut gamag mwasanin mo inekes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Bo iyousis Yon inawes wa̱deil.” Yeisuw iligen mo inoun in Galiliy.
In Nasalet, ilisow, in Kapaneyum mo isin. Ven towen wakawalaw, kweiboug tasiyas Seblon son Naptal siven.
Palopit kweiboug Isaya nilivnek mamagina:

content.text: yol niweiw, ven towen Galiliy nimeim;
Kweiboug dadub, kamnat avakaein mo ikines.
Kweiboug ven kanig-nen misikes, kamnat mo isap wasigeis.”

content: Kweiboug palopit nilivnek, tut towen bo ikamat.
Yeisuw mo isilamaw nageiguy, ilana, “Kulavewas amisinap kalbaleb, peinan Yowbad kakita bisilamaw nakaleiwag.”
Taplapouls asteivas
Ivayal yevagam towen yagan Galiliy, ikin taw teitan son bwadan iplapouls, mtowen Saymon, kweitan yagan Pita, bwadan Andiluw, peinan siwotet poul-wan.
Yeisuw idibakes, ilana, “Kukikuns waseg yey, mo basekeimiy kweitan miwot, waseg bukukwanes gamag.”
Iliganes, ipiyaves wot towen, ikikuns Yeisuw waseg.
Inounas, ineis mo ikines tawaw asteiy, Sebidiy nitun, Yemes son bwadan Yon, tasiyas sisiy times wa̱wag iymiyeims siwot. Yeisuw idawes, mo ilisawes wag towen, ilisawes times, mo ikikuns Yeisuw waseg.
Ilabes gamag babaw
Ita̱vin ven babaw Galiliy waseg, igeiguy buntuman tapwa̱loul sinagog wasigeis, livan bwanabwein isekes va̱gan bikakins Yowbad nakaleiwag; takatouns ivag ibweins; tasiyas abes igeg, ilabes mo ibweins.

Tasiyas min-Siliy mo iliganes butun Yeisuw, imeyes takatouns, askatoun kweitan kweitan, ivag mo ibweins, tasiyas igidaged wous, tasiyas bwagaw neiweiys, takabalamats, tayda̱gwegs, ivag mo ibweins asibabaw.
Gamag babaw mo ikikuns waseg, tasiyas min-Galiliy, min-Dikapolis, min-Yelusalem, min-Yudiy, sisiyas tasiyas palata-dadan Yoldan, ikikuns waseg Yeisuw.
